evidence.p4_benchmark: P4 tested 4 compression levels across 4 snapshot types. BALANCED preserved all critical fields (frozen_conclusions, current_strategy, active_risks, next_recommended, blocked_phases) while reducing size by ~60% vs FULL.
evidence.p4_r1_coverage: P4-R1 extended benchmark to 24 snapshots across 6 types x 4 compression levels. BALANCED consistently passed freshness validation across all 24.
evidence.fresh_window_simulation: Loading a BALANCED Snapshot Pack provides: frozen_conclusions (all 14), current_strategy flags (all), active_risks (all non-legacy), next_recommended phases (2), blocked_phases (all). Sufficient for fresh-window continuation.
